thread:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a targeted 'contract slimdown' for inference-config. Goal: reduce surface area, move policy evaluation out to policy-plane, and create a temporary debt-sink for old adapters.
aj: Sounds sensible. Can you outline the migration steps?
maria: High-level: 1) introduce policy-plane API (read-only) 2) start dual-write for policy metadata 3) canary route 10% traffic for 2 weeks 4) cut over 100% and retire legacy hooks.
simon: Are we sure dual-write is safe? race conditions for edits?
maria: We avoid dual-write for edits. Plan: authoritative writes go to new policy-plane, legacy adapters read from it via a thin sync job for 48h, then we switch reads.
katie: What about DB schema changes? we'll need a migration window for the policy table.
maria: Migration pattern: backfill new table from old snapshot, then run incremental sync using CDC. Simple SQL snippet: 
```sql
INSERT INTO policy_plane.policies (id, cfg, updated_at)
SELECT id, cfg, updated_at FROM legacy.inference_policies WHERE updated_at <= :snapshot_ts;
```
Followed by CDC consumer to apply updates.
aj: Good. How to handle feature flags and canarying?
maria: We'll add a config flag per-tenant route in the router: `policy_plane_route=enabled|legacy`. Start with 10% tenants in enabled bucket. Use the router metric `router.policy_plane_errors` to gate.
infra-bot: deploy check: canary requires new envoy filter + router config change. Apply with staged k8s rollout: `kubectl set image deployment/router router=router:policy-plane-canary -n inference`
simon: Rollback plan?
maria: If errors > 0.5% or latency P95 increases by >30ms for 10m, roll back to legacy. We'll keep a fallback that rewrites to legacy when TTL miss occurs.
katie: Owners and timelines?
maria: Owners: maria (arch lead), aj (runtime), simon (router), infra (ops). Timeline: spike + tests this sprint, canary next sprint, full cut late next month.
aj: Any tests we should run before canary? e2e + load + a small chaos test. Also linting of contract: make sure new API returns stable schema.
simon: Need a compatibility shim for the older adapters that expect `policy_v1` -> map to `policy_v2` fields. Can add shim in the sync job.
katie: Cost implications? CDC + extra reads add marginal cost. We should track tokenized-policy lookup QPS.
maria: Agree — we'll track `policy_plane_lookups`, `policy_sync_lag`, `router.policy_plane_errors`, and `adapter.fallback_count`.
aj: One more: add a debt-sink backlog ticket to the ledger so we don't forget to audit legacy adapters post-cutover.
maria: Created ticket INF-4532 (debt-sink: audit & prune legacy adapters). I'll post the checklist in the RFC doc.
simon: Thx — looks solid. I can own the envoy filter changes.
infra-bot: Note: schedule maintenance window if any schema locks > 5m.
katie: Let's sync tomorrow 10am for cutover dry-run.
maria: Thanks all. I'll update the RFC with migration script and monitoring dashboards. :rocket:
